issues.description: The methods getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() have inconsistent visibility: the Problem Statement and test names require public getters for each attribute (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), while the Solution Repository declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. The Template Repository only contains TODO placeholders for adding getters. This mismatch means the canonical solution does not expose the expected public API, which is confusing for students and will prevent external code/tests from calling these getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the access modifier of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() in the solution to public so they match the problem statement and expected tests. Update the template guidance (or provide example signatures) to indicate that all attribute getters should be public. For example, in Lecture.java declare: public String getLectureName() { ... } and public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents() { ... }.
